sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RiskMandate's song Know the Reach is on Spotify, and the first 53 seconds of its video were made with AI.
sections.para: Made by Silvio Switha from about 2,300 words of direction: 43 images, 16 motion clips, 21 edited exports, eight decisions and 1,236 Runway credits.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: The song, the video, the counts, the human part, the spend, and what is left.

sections.label: The song
sections.line: Know the Reach puts RiskMandate's three words to music: reach, mandate and the gap.
sections.para: On Spotify now, about three and a half minutes long.

sections.label: The first part of the video
sections.line: 53.4 seconds from 14 clips: one protagonist, Lisbon from night to morning, an agent as golden light.
sections.para: The instrumental opening explains the product; small labels follow. It plays here from YouTube, on a click.

sections.label: How it was made
sections.line: 43 images, 16 motion clips and 21 exports, from about 2,300 words of human input.
sections.para: 49 images reused, one eight-second test first, a budget per shot, and local edits after that.

sections.label: Eight decisions
sections.line: Eight decisions, most of them judgement rather than generation.
sections.para: Accurate claims, the song as the timing reference, and type readable on a phone.

sections.para: Saved project and three chats; exports are versions; 464 gallery entries are not new images.
